parameters.query:
SELECT i.id, i.invoice_number, i.invoice_type, i.net_amount, i.gst_amount, i.pst_amount,
       i.amount_due, i.holdback_amount, i.description, i.last_client_html, i.status,
       i.email_sent_at, i.issued_date, i.due_date, i.company_id,
       i.billing_percentage, i.billed_basis,
       p.title AS project_name, c.name AS customer_name, c.company_name AS customer_company,
       c.email, c.street_address AS bill_street, c.city AS bill_city,
       c.province AS bill_province, c.postal_code AS bill_postal,
       cp.email_from, cp.email_from_name, cp.street_address, cp.city, cp.province,
       cp.postal_code, cp.phone, cp.signature_name, cp.brand_primary_color,
       cp.brand_accent_color, cp.brand_success_color, cp.portal_base_url,
       cp.gst_reg_number, cp.pst_reg_number, cp.payment_instructions, cp.retention_rate, cp.logo_data, cp.logo_content_type
FROM invoices i
JOIN projects p ON p.id = i.project_id
JOIN customers c ON c.id = p.customer_id
JOIN company_profile cp ON cp.id = p.company_id
WHERE i.company_id = $2::smallint AND (i.id::text = $1 OR i.invoice_number = $1)
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE invoices SET email_sent_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
       status = CASE WHEN status = 'DRAFT' THEN 'UNPAID' ELSE status END
 WHERE company_id = $2 AND (id::text = $1 OR invoice_number = $1) AND email_sent_at IS NULL
 RETURNING invoice_number;

INSERT INTO invoice_email_log (invoice_id, company_id, kind)
SELECT i.id, i.company_id, 'reject' FROM invoices i
WHERE i.company_id = $1 AND (i.id::text = $2 OR i.invoice_number = $2)
RETURNING id;

SELECT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM invoice_line_items li
  JOIN invoices o ON o.id = li.invoice_id
  WHERE li.source_type = 'change_order'
    AND li.source_id IN (SELECT source_id FROM invoice_line_items WHERE invoice_id = $1)
    AND o.id <> $1 AND o.status <> 'DRAFT'
) AS dup;
